upcoming_earnings.ai_summary_en: TSM is scheduled to report earnings on 2026-10-15 with an EPS estimate of 4.46 and revenue estimate of 45.81B. The company maintains a perfect historical beat rate of 1.0, reflecting consistent execution in advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Focus remains on AI accelerator demand and foundry capacity utilization.
